Subject: Q3 wrap: scoring rubric, narrative excerpts, and comms timeline

Hi all,

Attached is the consolidated scoring rubric and an evidence index for Q3. Goals for this thread:

- Agree final numeric scores for each objective by EOD Wed (5 Aug).
- Collect short 1-2 sentence narrative excerpts per objective for the exec QBR slide deck.
- Confirm which items need a 1:1 calibration call (flagged in the rubric).

Key notes: the rubric has two columns — "raw metric score" (0-5) and "evidence pass" (yes/no). Where there is a discrepancy between metric and qualitative progress, please add a 1-2 line justification in the "annotations" column.

I attached: Q3-OKR-rubric.xlsx (master tab), evidence-index.csv (links to dashboards & screenshots). Also included a short template at the end for the exec narrative.

Please reply inline with: 1) your proposed score adjustments, 2) any annotations, 3) whether you want a 15-min calibration sync. I'll own consolidation and final publish to the Exec Drive.

Thanks,
Naomi

Naomi — thanks for pulling this together. Quick reads below (inline):

> Objective 1: API latency P95 reduction (target: 25% improvement)
- Raw metric score currently 4. Metric evidence shows 23% improvement. I propose keeping at 4 but mark "evidence pass = partial" pending the service-level trace export (see evidence-index row 7).

> Objective 2: Dedicated adoption (target: 120 customers)
- Raw metric score 3; but churn-adjusted adoption is closer to 110. I think we should score a 3 and include this note: "pipeline momentum strong; revenue recognition deferred due to contract timing."

> Objective 4: Console observability adoption
- I am suggesting a 2->3 because we shipped the dashboards but adoption is still limited to 3 pilot accounts. We should flag for a short calibration with Product-Led Growth next week.

I added comments in the rubric (column "Vivek notes"). For any items marked as "disputed" I've set a red flag — let's discuss those quickly on Mon 2 Aug if folks are free.

Vivek
VP Engineering
